definitions.U1_SOLE_MIXED_YI: one ungraded 忌, 宜 from officer and 吉神 together
definitions.U2_SOLE_OFFICER_YI: one ungraded 忌, 宜 from the day officer only (滿日 …)
definitions.U3_SOLE_JISHEN_YI: one ungraded 忌, 宜 from 吉神 only (德, 月恩/四相/時德, 三合 …)
definitions.U4_MULTIPLE_JI: two or more surviving 忌 operands
definitions.U5_PUZHU06_KEPT: one ungraded 忌 kept by puzhu:06 (QL_EXCLUDED: Q4a / F1 R2)
definitions.U7_PROTECTED_CO_OPERAND: 忌 protected by a co-operand (百忌, 專忌, 八專 …)

u7SourceLines.zhuanji: 「除建破等日條例簡易及專忌之日無庸分别」 takes 專忌 days out of the grade framework; puzhu:22 「如遇專忌之日則仍註忌」 keeps their 忌. Neither line says how 宜 combines
u7SourceLines.tufu: 「凡土府土符地囊止註忌補垣亦不註宜塞穴」: 宜 withheld for 塞穴 only (not a P4 heading)
u7SourceLines.siji: 「凡四忌四窮止忌安葬如遇鳴吠鳴吠對亦不註宜破土啟攢」: specific headings only
u7SourceLines.heidao: 六黑道 「與凶神併則從所忌與吉神併則從所宜」 concerns the 黑道 gods themselves
u7SourceLines.result: no general source line on 宜 against a protected 忌; U7 rows reach both_present through the same A05 default in code, but their provenance is UNVERIFIED, not established

provenanceScope: IMPLEMENTATION_DEFAULT is established for the sole-ungraded families U1, U2, U3, U5; U4 and U7 are unverified
note: puzhu:21/22 and 相抵 never produce both_present rows (they end in neither_recorded / lifted); propagation shows only as propagationBlocked on protected rows
